'''Haril Zense''' was a [[Spy/Legends|spy]] for the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel alliance]] on [[Ord Radama/Legends|Ord Radama]]. Haril was gathering proof about the Rebel Alliance being innocent in the [[Bombing of Rialla Way]]. He assisted the [[Ardan resistance]] in finding [[Var Narek]], a traitor to the Ardan Resistance.<ref name="OaA1" />
